title: Repair Archive (seed): Repair Traditions Atlas and Repair Record data standard
description: An open, citable seed for the repair archival intelligence proposed in Alvi (2026), 'Stitched Knowledge: Fashion Archives, Global Repair Traditions, and the Case for Archival Intelligence in Sustainable Practice' (SCIN 2026; Springer Advances in Science, Technology and Innovation). Contains the Repair Traditions Atlas (traditions scored against a seven-dimension schema), the Repair Record data standard (human-readable specification and JSON Schema), and a first deposited record of invisible reweaving (rafoogari). Version 0.1: openly incomplete and built to be extended with practitioners and curators.
